tasks.short: Identify landscaping pests and order suitable treatments

steps.what: Inspect landscaping and identify likely diseases or pests and alternative causes
Retrieve current treatment guidance and check applicability to the observed problem
Choose and order appropriate treatments or request specialist identification

tasks.design: Index current authorised treatment guidance in {DOCS} for source retrieval. The supervisor inspects the site, checks applicability and personally chooses or orders treatment; uncertain identification is referred rather than treated as a model diagnosis.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searching among reference sheets for the relevant treatment guidance.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexing and bookmarks can reduce reference navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Disease, pest damage and environmental stress can look similar, and treatment permissions vary.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty and avoid an unnecessary or unsuitable treatment.
tasks.altitude: Less reference searching with unchanged diagnostic and purchasing responsibility.

reach.learn: Useful specimens, symptom history and site context

evidence.claim: Indexed source guidance can assist retrieval without automating pest identification or treatment choice.

assumptions: Boundary ends with a treatment order or specialist referral; treatment application and specialist work are excluded and unchanged.

Supervisor produces site observations and provisional identification in s1, retaining all time. Search terms, host plant, location and source applicability are checked in s2 within its retained 60%. Guidance owners supply current documents through their existing process. Missing current guidance or uncertain identity requires manual clarification, not guessed treatment.
Test native document search before custom code. Supervisor acts only within local qualifications, permitted uses and purchasing delegation; software grants no new authority.
unknowns: Local permissions and available specialist support
research_questions: Does indexing shorten lookup after checking host, problem and treatment applicability?

already_counted.description: Verify source applicability and unresolved reference details

approvals.approved_version: Exact site, problem, treatment or referral, quantity and supplier selected before order; any change requires another check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=94; gross 6 less upkeep 1 gives net 5. High assumes recurring reference searches; low assumes uncertain cases consume the lookup gain. Inspection and treatment decisions retain 85 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inventory usable tools, equipment and materials

steps.what: Inventory physical quantities and inspect tools, equipment and materials for usability
Record usable inventory quantities and required supply levels
Compare usable quantities against supply targets and list inventory shortages

tasks.design: Capture the existing checked inventory table in {OPS_SYSTEM} and configure a simple comparison with its supply targets. The shortage list is arithmetic only; all counting, usability judgement and target checking remain with the supervisor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison of the same quantities and target levels.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock views can calculate shortages from checked inputs.
tasks.still_hard: A nominally present tool may be unusable, and the work plan can change supply needs.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish available inventory from inventory safe and suitable for use.
tasks.altitude: Less shortage arithmetic with unchanged stock and condition responsibility.

reach.task: Arrange repair of tools found unusable
reach.learn: Clear condition descriptions and isolation procedures

evidence.claim: A native inventory view can compare captured usable quantities and targets without inferring tool condition.

assumptions: Boundary ends with a shortage list, excluding ordering, repair and equipment issue.

Supervisor produces quantities and condition observations in s1 and captures item ID, site, date, total quantity, usable quantity, unit and checked target in s2. Both retain full time. Existing targets were set by the supervisor in normal planning; checking applicability is included in s2 and recurring changes are in upkeep.

Missing quantity, usability or target fields are marked unresolved in s2 and compared manually there; s3 calculates only complete rows and never assumes a missing value is zero. No new stock code or par level is supplied without a producer.
Test native stock configuration first. Machine time is not baseline system runtime; the saving is solely the supervisor's former manual comparison.
research_questions: Can complete inventory rows produce a reliable shortage list without extra capture?

already_counted.description: Capture fields, check targets and handle incomplete rows manually

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90; gross 10 minus upkeep 2 gives net 8. High assumes complete checked rows; low assumes changing targets and incomplete rows consume comparison gains. Physical inspection retains 75 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather and verify required personnel information and project activity facts
Enter verified information into required personnel or project records
Check record completeness, correct exceptions and file the required records

tasks.design: Use native forms and views in {HCM} and {PROJECT} to reuse verified inputs instead of copying them into a parallel {SPREADSHEET}. Keep personnel access separate from project reporting and retain all factual verification and final completeness checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Parallel registers repeated data already checked elsewhere.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record views can reuse entered facts with access controls.
tasks.still_hard: A complete record can still contain an unauthorised or incorrect change.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve contradictory facts without exposing confidential personnel information.
tasks.altitude: Less record copying with unchanged accountability for completeness.

reach.learn: Access limits, lawful record content and correction history

evidence.claim: Suite MKB supports landscaper planning, quotes and customer records; that supports the availability of sector operations software, not automated personnel decisions.
Native forms and views can reduce duplicate record entry while retaining verification.

assumptions: Boundary covers required record maintenance, excluding work performance, hiring and payroll calculation. Reconcile ownership with any separate time-recording task before roll-up.

Supervisor produces verified inputs in s1 with record type, person or project ID, event date, source reference, authorised change and factual activity. Full gathering and capture time remains. HR and work-record producers retain their existing effort. Missing mappings or authorisation require manual entry and checking in s2 or s3.
Test native records and access configuration before integrations. Do not combine staff files with client views, add sickness causes or score staff. No saving from existing runtime.
research_questions: Can native views remove repeat entry without losing required history or access controls?

already_counted.description: Check reused fields and handle mapping exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain record mappings and access exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=72; gross 28 less upkeep 4 gives net 24. High assumes parallel entry can be removed; low assumes unstructured exceptions consume gains. Verification and final checks retain 65 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Handle hiring, performance and disciplinary matters

steps.what: Gather relevant personnel evidence and discuss the worker or candidate's circumstances
Evaluate evidence and carry out authorised hiring, performance or disciplinary actions

tasks.design: Keep evidence gathering, conversations and consequential personnel judgement with the supervisor and the existing HR process. The {HCM} remains the existing authorised record source; this design adds no automated staff ranking or invented preparation work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fair personnel decisions require context, dialogue and delegated authority.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability is assumed to replace that judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete evidence and unequal opportunities can distort an apparently simple performance comparison.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to the person's account and recognise when the work conditions explain the problem.
tasks.altitude: Personnel conversations and decision rights are unchanged.

reach.task: Check a proposed action against the appropriate personnel procedure
reach.learn: Evidence quality, fair process and escalation limits

evidence.claim: Hiring, performance and disciplinary decisions need contextual human judgement; no labour saving is assumed here.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor evidence gathering, discussion and action within existing delegation. HR approval, recruitment administration and required record maintenance stay with their existing owners and are not added as free savings.

Supervisor gathers the person's account and relevant observed facts in s1 with full time retained; there is no new structured input or generated rating. Missing evidence is resolved through existing discussion and HR escalation.
Native record access is considered first; no new system is implemented. Zero incremental upkeep because the personnel workflow is unchanged. No runtime or other-role effort enters the saving.
unknowns: Delegated authority and local personnel rules
research_questions: Which personnel cases need earlier HR involvement?

incremental.description: No change means no additional workflow upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and upkeep 0. Routine and difficult personnel cases retain all conversation and judgement time; no unsupported administrative baseline is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The supervisor retains site and personnel judgement while reducing repeated comparisons and record entry.
reach: Coordinate specialist pest identification, equipment repair and fair personnel review
role.ambitious_version: Run grounds work with clearer evidence while keeping treatment and personnel choices with competent people.

job.title: First-Line Supervisors of Landscaping, Lawn Service, and Groundskeeping Workers
